remediation_R5.finding: SMB-INTEROP-PSD-WIDE CONFIRMED (validation/R5-review-a.json, 1d404f8/213b30a): proposal.rs gray route dropped black point compensation for every gray profile on the false premise TRC(0)=0
remediation_R5.root_fix: BPC goes to Prism unchanged for every source kind (WideRoute.bpc = bpc); the black_point_compensation_skipped_gray loss code and Routing.bpc_requested are removed. Prism's ISO 18619 gray black detection is fixed upstream (PRISM-GRAY-BPC-001 closed by SMB-PRISM-ENG-6, fdd57ee/3926709, in HEAD and origin) and is the exact identity when the source black is 0, so no TRC(0)=0 shortcut and no bpc_unavailable workaround are used
remediation_R5.counterfactual: old code (bpc && kind != Gray) outputs v0+(1-v0)g for the TRC(0)>0 profile and records black_point_compensation_skipped_gray; the new test asserts output g (3e-3) and the absence of that code. The same test checks BPC off = v0+(1-v0)g, so the compensation is measurable (v0=6554/65535). TRC(0)=0 (gamma 2) profile: BPC on == BPC off byte for byte
remediation_R5.v4_06_class: colour-management step silently skipped (a configured or assumed intent / black point compensation / embedded profile is dropped, hard-coded or bypassed without a typed loss entry)

notes.prism_defect_for_prism_lane: FIXED upstream (PRISM-GRAY-BPC-001, SMB-PRISM-ENG-6) and the importer workaround is removed (remediation_R5). Original report: WideEngine Gray kTRC source with black_point_compensation=true: BpcReport.source_black_lstar is garbage (gamma 2.0 profile: -3613.19, scale 0.2; gamma 1.8: -1.5e11), output for gray 0.25 is 0.85 instead of 0.25; with BPC off results are correct. Cause: companion PCS value for gray input exactly 0.0 is not 0 (clip report on the same call shows overshoot 4.0 for 1 pixel, channels [1,1,1]). Repro: v2.1 mntr GRAY/XYZ profile, wtpt D50, kTRC curv count=1 gamma u8Fixed8 0x0200 (tests/common/icc.rs gray_profile(2.0)), destination sRGB-linear-v4, Relative colorimetric, BPC on, pixels [0,0.5,1]. Importer works around it by not sending BPC for gray (gray black is Y=0 so BPC is the identity against a matrix destination).
